title: 3 tips to become a top 1% agent operator
description: The gap between an average agent operator and the top 1 percent is not the model. It is that they actually read their transcripts. Every conversation and tool call your agent makes is stored, and it is the best memory, observability and skill-debugging tool you have. Most people never open them. Link in bio if you want to go deeper.
